subject: Aligning C-suite to finalize pilot runway
message_1_subject: Aligning C-suite to finalize pilot runway
message_1_body:
Hi Sara,

Thanks again for a very productive discovery earlier today — appreciate the clarity on FinArc's latency and compliance constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock the pilot runway: 

- Recap: primary goals are to reduce inference latency for real-time scoring to <120ms P95, keep customer data within your VPC, and retain audit logs for 12 months.
- Ask from Redwood: schedule a short exec alignment (VP/CTO) to confirm success criteria, procurement/timeline constraints, and preferred rollout guardrails.

Suggested slots (PST):
1) Tue 8/17 10:00–10:45
2) Wed 8/18 15:00–15:45

If those don't work, tell me two windows that do and we'll match. Can you confirm which FinArc execs will attend (VP of ML or CTO)? Id like to include Marissa (sales lead) and Karthik (solutions engineer) on the thread to prep the technical runbook and MOS (mutual action plan).

I've attached a short one-page discovery summary and uploaded a draft mutual action plan to the shared link below for visibility.

Attachments: 2027-08-12_Discovery_Notes.pdf
Shared MxAP: https://docs.redwood.com/mutual-action/FP-FN-4821

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
message_2_subject: Re: Aligning C-suite to finalize pilot runway
message_2_body:
Diego —

Thanks for the recap and the doc. Maria (cc'd) is our CTO and will want to confirm the SLA and VPC architecture. She can make either of the two slots you suggested, but Maria asked if we can shift the Tue option to 11:00–11:45 due to a standing commitment.

If you can do Tue 8/17 11:00–11:45 that would be ideal. Attendees from our side: Maria Ortega (CTO), myself (Head of Data), and Samir Patel (VP of Engineering, tentative). We'll confirm Samir shortly.

Two quick asks before the call:
- Can your SE prep a 10-min infra sketch (network footprint, egress/KMS pattern)?
- Can you share the high-level commercial bands for a dedicated pilot (monthly committed capacity + overage)?

I'll wait for confirmation.

Sincerely,
Sara
Sara Lin
Head of Data | FinArc
message_3_cc: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@finarc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

message_3_body:
Sara —

11:00–11:45 on Tue 8/17 works for us; confirming the slot. 

Notes on your asks:
- Karthik (cc) will do the 10-minute infra sketch and bring an ops checklist (VPC peering, KMS flow, audit log endpoints).
- I'll include a commercial anchor in the pre-read: baseline pilot bands + overage estimates so you can surface to procurement.

One request: can we do a 20-minute pre-brief with Maria and Karthik the morning of 8/17 (08:30–08:50 PT)? It's purely optional but helps shorten the exec conversation to decision points. If Maria can't, we can skip.

I'll have Marissa send the calendar invite and include the mutual action plan we discussed.

Thanks — see you Tuesday.
